<!-- ondo-css --><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Silkscreen:wght@400;700&display=swap"><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.9/dist/web/variable/pretendardvariable-dynamic-subset.min.css"><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/galmuri@2.40.3/dist/galmuri.css"><style>/* ondo 사이트 공통 CSS (2026-11-11 전체 개편: 픽셀 + 온도계)
   원칙(사용자 10-31): 겉(로고·라벨·구분선)은 도트로 가볍게, 속(본문·표·그래프)은 깔끔하고 정확하게.
   - 브랜드 층: Silkscreen(영어 전용 도트 글꼴), 남색 + 온도 색
   - 읽기 층: Pretendard, 밝은 종이색 바탕 (글 본문 인라인 스타일이 밝은 바탕 기준이라 그대로 살아남)
   theme_push.py 가 이 파일을 header 부품 맨 앞 <style>로 넣는다. */

:root {
  --o-ink: #18202c;
  --o-ink-2: #4a5568;
  --o-ink-3: #5c6575;
  --o-paper: #f7f4ec;
  --o-card: #fffdf7;
  --o-line: #e3dccb;
  --o-navy: #10203b;
  --o-navy-2: #1a2e52;
  --o-navy-3: #2a4373;
  --o-cold: #3d6dff;
  --o-cool: #2bb3c0;
  --o-mild: #f4c44e;
  --o-warm: #ff8a3d;
  --o-hot: #ec4a37;
  --o-px: 'Silkscreen', 'Courier New', monospace;
  --o-sans: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif;
  --o-wrap: 1200px;
  --o-read: 720px;
  --o-grad: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--o-cold), var(--o-cool), var(--o-mild), var(--o-warm), var(--o-hot));
}

/* ── 바탕 ───────────────────────────────────────── */
html body { background: var(--o-paper) !important; color: var(--o-ink); font-family: var(--o-sans); word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: break-word; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
html body .wp-site-blocks { background: var(--o-paper); padding-top: 0 !important; }
html body a { color: var(--o-navy-3); }
.o-wrap { max-width: var(--o-wrap); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; box-sizing: border-box; }
.o-px { font-family: var(--o-px); letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* 도트 구분선: 온도 색 칸이 이어진 줄 */
.o-pxline { height: 8px; background:
  linear-gradient(90deg, var(--o-cold) 0 20%, var(--o-cool) 20% 40%, var(--o-mild) 40% 60%, var(--o-warm) 60% 80%, var(--o-hot) 80% 100%);
  -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 8px, transparent 8px 12px); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 8px, transparent 8px 12px); }

/* 도트 모서리 상자(계단식 테두리) */
.o-pxbox { position: relative; background: var(--o-card); border: 0; margin: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 0 0 var(--o-ink), 0 4px 0 0 var(--o-ink), -4px 0 0 0 var(--o-ink), 4px 0 0 0 var(--o-ink), 0 0 0 4px var(--o-card) inset; }

/* 테마 기본 블록 간격(머리말 아래 빈 띠) 없애기 - 간격은 각 구역 안쪽 여백으로만 */
html body .wp-site-blocks > *, html body .wp-site-blocks > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; margin-top: 0 !important; }
html body header.wp-block-template-part, html body footer.wp-block-template-part { margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; }

/* ── 머리말 ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.o-head { background: var(--o-navy); color: #fff; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; }
body.admin-bar .o-head { top: 32px; }
.o-head .o-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; height: 64px; }
.o-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #fff !important; text-decoration: none !important; }
.o-logo svg { width: 18px; height: 36px; image-rendering: pixelated; shape-rendering: crispEdges; }
.o-logo b { font-family: var(--o-px); font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.o-logo small { font-family: var(--o-px); font-size: 10px; color: var(--o-mild); letter-spacing: .1em; display: block; margin-top: -2px; }
.o-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center; }
.o-nav a { color: #d9e1f2 !important; text-decoration: none !important; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 2px; }
.o-nav a:hover, .o-nav a.is-on { color: #fff !important; background: var(--o-navy-2); box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--o-mild); }
.o-nav .o-nav-board { color: var(--o-navy) !important; background: var(--o-mild); font-family: var(--o-px); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.o-nav .o-nav-board:hover { background: var(--o-warm); color: var(--o-navy) !important; box-shadow: none; }
.o-menu-btn { display: none; background: none; border: 0; color: #fff; font-family: var(--o-px); font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px; }
.o-head .o-pxline { height: 4px; }
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .o-menu-btn { display: block; }
  .o-nav { display: none; position: absolute; top: 64px; left: 0; right: 0; background: var(--o-navy); flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; padding: 8px 16px 16px; }
  .o-nav.is-open { display: flex; }
  .o-nav a { padding: 12px; font-size: 16px; }
}

/* ── 바닥글 ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.o-foot { background: var(--o-navy); color: #b9c4da; margin-top: 0; font-size: 14px; }
.o-foot .o-wrap { padding-top: 40px; padding-bottom: 40px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
.o-foot h4 { font-family: var(--o-px); color: var(--o-mild); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .1em; margin: 0 0 12px; font-weight: 400; }
.o-foot a { color: #e3e9f5 !important; text-decoration: none !important; display: block; padding: 3px 0; }
.o-foot a:hover { color: var(--o-mild) !important; }
.o-foot .o-soon { display: block; padding: 3px 0; color: #b9c4da; }
.o-soon { cursor: default; }
.o-nav .o-soon.o-nav-board { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 2px; }
.o-foot p { margin: 0 0 8px; line-height: 1.7; }
.o-foot .o-copy { border-top: 1px solid var(--o-navy-3); padding: 16px 24px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: #8391ad; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .o-foot .o-wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; } }

/* ── 첫 화면 ────────────────────────────────────── */
.o-hero { background: var(--o-navy); color: #fff; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
.o-hero::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: .14;
  background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.5) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.5) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 24px 24px; }
.o-hero .o-wrap { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr; gap: 40px; align-items: center; padding-top: 72px; padding-bottom: 72px; }
.o-hero-kick { font-family: var(--o-px); color: var(--o-mild); font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: .14em; margin: 0 0 14px; }
.o-hero h1 { font-family: var(--o-px) !important; font-weight: 700 !important; font-size: clamp(28px, 6vw, 68px) !important; line-height: 1.05 !important; letter-spacing: .02em; margin: 0 0 18px !important; color: #fff !important; text-transform: uppercase; }
.o-hero h1 span { color: var(--o-warm); }
.o-hero p.o-hero-sub { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.7; color: #d4dcec; max-width: 34em; margin: 0 0 28px; }
.o-btn { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--o-px); font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-decoration: none !important; padding: 12px 18px; color: var(--o-navy) !important; background: var(--o-mild);
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 0 0 var(--o-mild), 0 4px 0 0 var(--o-mild), -4px 0 0 0 var(--o-mild), 4px 0 0 0 var(--o-mild), 4px 8px 0 0 #000; margin: 4px 12px 4px 4px; }
.o-btn:hover { background: var(--o-warm); box-shadow: 0 -4px 0 0 var(--o-warm), 0 4px 0 0 var(--o-warm), -4px 0 0 0 var(--o-warm), 4px 0 0 0 var(--o-warm), 2px 4px 0 0 #000; transform: translate(2px, 2px); }
.o-btn.is-ghost { background: transparent; color: #fff !important; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #fff; }
.o-hero-thermo { display: flex; justify-content: center; }
.o-hero-thermo svg { width: min(220px, 60%); height: auto; shape-rendering: crispEdges; image-rendering: pixelated; }
.o-mercury { animation: o-rise 2.4s steps(10) infinite alternate; transform-origin: bottom; transform-box: fill-box; }
@keyframes o-rise { from { transform: scaleY(.35); } to { transform: scaleY(1); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .o-mercury { animation: none; } }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .o-hero .o-wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding-top: 48px; padding-bottom: 48px; } .o-hero-thermo { order: -1; } .o-hero-thermo svg { width: 64px; } }

.o-sec { padding: 64px 0 0; }
.o-sec-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.o-sec-head h2 { font-size: 26px !important; font-weight: 800 !important; margin: 0 !important; color: var(--o-ink) !important; }
.o-sec-head .o-px { font-size: 12px; color: var(--o-ink-3); }

/* 분야 입구 카드 */
.o-cats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
.o-cat { display: block; text-decoration: none !important; color: var(--o-ink) !important; background: var(--o-card); border: 2px solid var(--o-ink); padding: 22px 22px 20px; position: relative; transition: transform .12s steps(2); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--o-ink); }
.o-cat:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--o-ink); }
.o-cat .o-px { font-size: 13px; color: var(--o-navy-3); }
.o-cat h3 { font-size: 21px !important; font-weight: 800 !important; margin: 8px 0 8px !important; color: var(--o-ink) !important; }
.o-cat p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--o-ink-2); }
.o-cat svg { position: absolute; right: 18px; top: 18px; width: 32px; height: 32px; shape-rendering: crispEdges; }
.o-cat.t-etf { border-top: 8px solid var(--o-cold); }
.o-cat.t-energy { border-top: 8px solid var(--o-warm); }
.o-cat.t-society { border-top: 8px solid var(--o-cool); }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .o-cats { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

/* 온도판 맛보기 띠 */
.o-boardband { margin-top: 64px; background: var(--o-navy-2); color: #fff; }
.o-boardband .o-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding-top: 28px; padding-bottom: 28px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.o-boardband p { margin: 0; color: #d4dcec; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 40em; }
.o-boardband .o-px { color: var(--o-mild); font-size: 13px; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.o-scale { height: 12px; width: 220px; background: var(--o-grad); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 10px, transparent 10px 12px); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 10px, transparent 10px 12px); }

/* ── 글 목록 카드(첫 화면·분야·검색) ─────────────── */
.o-list .wp-block-post-template, ul.o-list { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.o-list .wp-block-post { background: var(--o-card); border: 1px solid var(--o-line); padding: 0 0 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: box-shadow .15s; }
.o-list .wp-block-post:hover { box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--o-line); }
.o-list .wp-block-post-featured-image { margin: 0 0 14px !important; }
.o-list .wp-block-post-featured-image img { aspect-ratio: 1200/630; object-fit: cover; width: 100%; display: block; }
.o-list .wp-block-post-terms { padding: 0 18px; font-family: var(--o-px); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.o-list .wp-block-post-terms a { color: var(--o-navy-3) !important; text-decoration: none !important; }
.o-list .wp-block-post-title { padding: 0 18px; margin: 6px 0 8px !important; font-size: 18px !important; line-height: 1.45 !important; font-weight: 800 !important; }
.o-list .wp-block-post-title a { color: var(--o-ink) !important; text-decoration: none !important; }
.o-list .wp-block-post-title a:hover { color: var(--o-navy-3) !important; }
.o-list .wp-block-post-excerpt { padding: 0 18px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--o-ink-2); margin: 0 !important; }
.o-list .wp-block-post-excerpt__more-text { display: none; }
.o-list .wp-block-post-date { padding: 0 18px; margin-top: auto !important; padding-top: 10px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--o-ink-3); }
.o-empty { border: 2px dashed var(--o-line); padding: 32px; text-align: center; color: var(--o-ink-2); background: var(--o-card); }
.o-empty .o-px { color: #b4471a; font-size: 14px; display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.wp-block-query-pagination { margin-top: 32px !important; font-family: var(--o-px); }
@media (max-width: 960px) { .o-list .wp-block-post-template, ul.o-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
@media (max-width: 620px) { .o-list .wp-block-post-template, ul.o-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

/* 목록 머리(분야·검색) */
.o-arch-head { background: var(--o-navy); color: #fff; padding: 48px 0 40px; }
.o-arch-head .o-px { color: var(--o-mild); font-size: 13px; }
.o-arch-head h1, .o-arch-head .wp-block-query-title { color: #fff !important; font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px) !important; font-weight: 800 !important; margin: 8px 0 8px !important; }
.o-arch-head .wp-block-term-description, .o-arch-head p { color: #d4dcec; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; max-width: 46em; }

/* ── 글 화면 ────────────────────────────────────── */
.o-post-head { background: var(--o-navy); color: #fff; padding: 48px 0 44px; }
.o-post-head .o-wrap { max-width: calc(var(--o-read) + 48px); }
.o-post-head .wp-block-post-terms { font-family: var(--o-px); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.o-post-head .wp-block-post-terms a { color: var(--o-mild) !important; text-decoration: none !important; }
.o-post-head .wp-block-post-title { color: #fff !important; font-size: clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 38px) !important; line-height: 1.35 !important; font-weight: 800 !important; margin: 10px 0 14px !important; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.o-post-head .o-meta { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; color: #aebbd4; font-size: 14px; }
.o-post-head .o-meta > * { margin: 0 !important; }
.o-post-head .wp-block-post-date, .o-post-head .wp-block-post-date time { color: #aebbd4 !important; }

.o-post { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, var(--o-read)) 300px; gap: 40px; justify-content: center; max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 40px 24px 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
.o-post > .o-toc-col { position: relative; }
.o-post > .o-side { position: relative; }
.o-post > .o-side > div { position: sticky; top: 96px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
@media (max-width: 1360px) { .o-post { grid-template-columns: 200px minmax(0, var(--o-read)); } .o-post > .o-side { grid-column: 2; } .o-post > .o-side > div { position: static; } }
@media (max-width: 1100px) { .o-post { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, var(--o-read)); } .o-post > .o-toc-col { display: none; } .o-post > .o-side { grid-column: 1; } }

/* 왼쪽 따라오는 목차(넓은 화면) + 글 위 접는 목차(좁은 화면) - 사용자가 좋아한 '왼쪽 따라오기' 유지 */
.o-toc { position: sticky; top: 96px; max-height: calc(100vh - 120px); overflow: auto; font-size: 14px; border-left: 4px solid var(--o-line); padding: 2px 0 2px 14px; }
.o-toc .o-px { font-size: 12px; color: var(--o-ink-3); display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.o-toc ol { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.o-toc li { margin: 0; }
.o-toc a { display: block; padding: 5px 0; color: var(--o-ink-2) !important; text-decoration: none !important; line-height: 1.45; }
.o-toc li.lv4 a { padding-left: 12px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--o-ink-3) !important; }
.o-toc a:hover { color: var(--o-ink) !important; }
.o-toc a.is-on { color: var(--o-ink) !important; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: -18px 0 0 -14px var(--o-warm); }
.o-toc-mob { display: none; margin: 0 0 28px; border: 2px solid var(--o-ink); background: var(--o-card); }
.o-toc-mob summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 12px 14px; font-family: var(--o-px); font-size: 13px; list-style: none; }
.o-toc-mob summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.o-toc-mob summary::after { content: ' +'; }
.o-toc-mob[open] summary::after { content: ' -'; }
.o-toc-mob ol { margin: 0; padding: 0 14px 12px 32px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8; }
.o-toc-mob a { color: var(--o-ink-2) !important; text-decoration: none !important; }
@media (max-width: 1100px) { .o-toc-mob.has-items { display: block; } }
/* 글 안에 원래 있는 '핵심 목차' 상자: 넓은 화면에선 왼쪽 목차가 대신하므로 숨기고, 좁은 화면에선 그대로 씀 */
@media (min-width: 1101px) { .o-read .o-intoc { display: none !important; } }

/* 본문 읽기 층 */
.o-read { min-width: 0; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content { font-size: 17.5px; line-height: 1.85; color: var(--o-ink); max-width: none !important; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content > * { max-width: none !important; margin-left: 0 !important; margin-right: 0 !important; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content p { margin: 0 0 1.25em; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content h2 { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.4; margin: 2.2em 0 .8em; color: var(--o-ink); }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content h3 { font-size: 23px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.45; margin: 2em 0 .7em; color: var(--o-ink); padding-left: 14px; border-left: 6px solid var(--o-warm); scroll-margin-top: 96px; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content h4 { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; margin: 1.6em 0 .6em; color: var(--o-ink); scroll-margin-top: 96px; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content h2 { scroll-margin-top: 96px; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content ul, .o-read .wp-block-post-content ol { padding-left: 1.3em; margin: 0 0 1.3em; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content li { margin: .35em 0; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content strong { font-weight: 700; color: var(--o-ink); }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content a { color: var(--o-navy-3); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 15px; margin: 1.4em 0; background: var(--o-card); display: block; overflow-x: auto; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content th { background: var(--o-navy); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content td { padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--o-line); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content blockquote { margin: 1.4em 0; padding: 14px 18px; border-left: 6px solid var(--o-mild); background: var(--o-card); color: var(--o-ink-2); }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content figure { margin: 1.6em 0; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content figcaption { font-size: 13px; color: var(--o-ink-3); text-align: center; margin-top: 6px; }
.o-read .finq-tip { border: 2px solid var(--o-ink) !important; background: var(--o-card) !important; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--o-mild); }
.o-read .ondo-chart, .o-read .ondo-visual { background: var(--o-card); border: 1px solid var(--o-line); padding: 8px; }
.o-read .wp-block-post-content > div[style*="height:1px"] { background: none !important; height: 8px !important; margin: 44px 0 !important;
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--o-line) 0 8px, transparent 8px 12px) !important; }

.o-byline { margin-top: 48px; display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; border-top: 2px solid var(--o-ink); padding-top: 20px; }

.o-arch-head h1, .o-read h2, .o-read h3, .obp-sec h3, .obp-name { font-family: var(--o-head) !important; font-weight: 700 !important; letter-spacing: 0 !important; }
